title: eucalyptus occidentalis var. macrantha
intro: Eucalyptus occidentalis var. macrantha, commonly known as the Western Spotted Gum, is a species of eucalyptus tree native to Western Australia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its decongestant and expectorant properties. The Western Spotted Gum also exhibits therapeutic actions as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and uses.
